required_gate: Run a matched full-session single-pass validation with external voltage motion correction and the claim mask disabled. It must preserve reviewed-event recovery and improve stable unit-family yield without increasing duplicates, contamination, or refractory violations.
operational_constraint: CUDA validation is available outside the sandbox. The remaining full-session candidate will require substantially more storage and runtime than the completed 120-s and 240-s gates.

evidence_domains.key_evidence: Luke has excess shared high-frequency voltage; imec1 retains a 3.51–5.31 positive/negative ratio after three reference controls.

evidence_domains.status: Implementation diagnosed; no incremental Luke benefit
evidence_domains.decision: Disable external voltage resampling in the rescue candidate
evidence_domains.key_evidence: No external correction recovered 85.2%; current DREDGE 70.4%, selected DREDGE 66.7%, and MEDiCINe 70.4%. However, all external sorts shared an uncalibrated p=1 interpolation path. On 128 matched neural events, calibrated p=2 retained median amplitude 95.4% versus 84.1% and local RMS 92.1% versus 80.6%. Sorter validation showed conservative p=2 was safe but neutral: in the 240-s replication it recovered 94.3%, identical to no-motion 94.3%. Adding it to single-pass preprocessing recovered 97.1%, identical to single-pass alone 97.1%; the 400/400 nonrigid p=2 control fell to 94.3%.
Effective KS-good families increased 123→163 in 240 s and 87→108 in 120 s, robust across agreement thresholds; event recovery was unchanged.

evidence_domains.decision: Interpolate, but exclude the synthetic row from claim metrics
evidence_domains.key_evidence: Interpolation preserved exact peak amplitude for 96% of 200 reviewed events and redirected all six false channel-191 peak localizations.
Every nonzero tested mask reduced reviewed-neural recovery; the production mask lost 25.9–48.6 percentage points in matched windows.

evidence_domains.decision: Do not claim lower Luke neural density
evidence_domains.key_evidence: Event density is reference-, polarity-, probe-, and layer-dependent; normalized depth is not matched cortical layer.

motion_interpolation_implementation_audi.sorter_conclusion: p2 fixes the p1 attenuation/explosion phenotype, but conservative motion is neural-recovery neutral and nonrigid motion is harmful across tested scales
